The radar then responds ok:true if no transport errors even when its source/next-day winner is absent.
prevention_rule: Use the existing stored materializer's JSON ok/state as source-stage authority, not HTTP success. Known original source shortages return ok:false, state:SOURCE_RECOVERY_DUE, typed MIRA_UNIQUE_SOURCE_WINNER_REQUIRED, same original radar owner and no extra sending. Append only original ONE BRAIN failure occurrence keyed by day/state, with idempotent SHA256. Unknown states and RPC transport errors fail closed. All 90-day source/3-day topic, date, Mira media >=0.940 and consent/provider gates remain unchanged.
fix_candidate: A small pure original shared materializer result classifier consumed by the same original Mira radar. Its existing output reports sourceRecovery without spinning up a new job; original Brain RPC records a source shortage once per day+state.
approval_boundaries: No additional search/API credits, scheduler, email sender, social publish, relaxation of uniqueness, substitution of historical media or invented provider readback.
